# `aitbc blockchain migrate`

Migrate a chain between two nodes with optional dry-run and verify.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain migrate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--from-node` | text | — | yes | The From node. |
| `--to-node` | text | — | yes | The To node. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Show migration plan without executing |
| `--verify` | flag | `false` | no | Verify migration after completion |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain migrate --chain-id <chain_id> --from-node <from_node> --to-node <to_node>
```
